props.name: items
props.description: Categories in any order. They are sorted largest first.

props.name: cutoff
props.description: Cumulative share, 0 to 1, that marks the vital few.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: What a bar measures — “Tickets”. Used in the legend and tooltip.

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values on the left axis and in the tooltip.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the key under the chart.
